notes: EmbeddingGemma 2 740M (litert-community/embeddinggemma-2-740m-litert-lm, Google's CPU/GPU bundle; sha256 computed on the phone and on the Mac after the push, equal) through LiteRT-LM 0.18.0's EmbeddingEngine in the hfmodels-android sample samples/eg2search (spoken sentence -> vector -> the nearest of the user's photos). The sample calls the runtime directly (not the SDK, which pins 0.16.1). Engine: backend GPU for the text backbone, visionBackend GPU for the photos, audioBackend CPU for the audio encoder (the delegate lines, evidence: the backbone and vision graphs whole on LITERT_CL, the audio encoder on XNNPACK), so full_delegation is written as #181(2) does for an audio-in bundle whose encoder stays on the CPU. latency_p50_ms = the median of three spoken queries' audio -> vector (2.0-2.6 s clips; top-1 = the gold photo on all three, so output_match stays null); the 36 photos' embeddings are photo_embed_*. The device check runs in the instrumentation process; the app on screen read 113.6-139.2 ms for the same clips (top-app), not entered. rerun_* = the supervisor's rerun of 2026-10-10 00:11 (thermal 1 when the hold was taken), slower: 234.2-271.1 ms. The NPU bundle (SM8850) did not initialize with the QAIRT 2.47 libraries on 2026-10-08 (probes/eg2demo/ROUND3.md) and is not a row here.
quantization: publisher's card: transformer and embeddings int4 per-channel (QAT), vision encoder int8 per-channel (QAT), audio encoder mixed int2/int4/int8 per-channel (QAT)
